anchor.notes: Melee knockback is cancelled both ways (arrows and explosions still move it); cannot wear boots.

barbarian.notes: Tyrfing upgrades with kills: 1 kill stone_sword, 2 iron_sword, 4 diamond_sword, then Sharpness at 6, 8 and 10.

beastmaster.notes: 3 wolf eggs and 4 bones, every bone tames; wolves attack whoever the owner fights and never a Werewolf.

berserker.notes: Strength I for 200 ticks after a mob kill, Strength II for 300 after a player kill, and cannot jump while it lasts.

cannibal.notes: Each hit on a player feeds the Cannibal and gives the victim Hunger I for 30 s; starts with a cod and an ocelot egg.

cookiemonster.notes: Grass drops cookies 1 in 5; a cookie is instant: food first, then 1 heart, then Speed II for 5 s at full health.

cultivator.notes: Anything planted is fully grown a tick later; starts with nothing.

demoman.notes: 2 mines: a stone pressure plate on gravel explodes at power 4 under anyone who steps on it, the Demoman included.

digger.notes: 6 eggs; 30 ticks after one is placed the 5x5 column under it, 8 deep, is removed.

endermage.notes: Placing the frame teleports everyone in its 5x5 column, any height, to it; all moved are immune for 100 ticks.

fighter.notes: A wooden sword and 2 cooked beef; no ability.

fireman.notes: Takes no damage from fire, burning, lava, lightning or hot blocks; still drowns and is still shoved by a Thor strike.

fisherman.notes: Reeling a hooked player flies them in an arc to the Fisherman's feet, up to 32 blocks, once per 40 ticks per victim.

flash.notes: Teleports up to 60 blocks to where it looks, with cosmetic lightning on arrival, Weakness for 1 s per 2 blocks and a 150 s cooldown.

forger.notes: Smelts iron, gold and copper in the inventory, one coal per ingot; no combat effect.

gambler.notes: Pressing its own placed button every 10 s rolls a random 30 s effect, good or bad; 1 in 1000 diamond armour, 1 in 1000 death.

gladiator.notes: Right-clicking a player takes both to a sealed 9x9 bedrock box at y 230 for 60 s; 3 s arrival immunity, 90 s cooldown.

grandpa.notes: The stick has hidden Knockback II: knockback:2 on a hit, knockback:3 when sprinting, and a fist's damage.

grappler.notes: Reeling launches the Grappler toward the hook and wipes its fall distance; 3 pulls, then 60 ticks rest.

hades.notes: Right-clicking a mob makes it a minion, up to 5; minions never hurt the owner and attack whoever the owner fights.

hermit.notes: Starts alone in the furthest swamp, jungle or desert; no items and no ability.

horseman.notes: Recognised by its saddled, iron-armoured horse that only the owner can ride; starts with a horse egg and 2 hay bales.

hulk.notes: Needs an empty main hand: right-click lifts a player or mob, left-click throws them 14 to 38 blocks; 5 s cooldown.

jackhammer.notes: Breaking a block with the stone axe breaks the whole column above it, one block every 2 ticks; 5 uses, then 30 s.

jellyfish.notes: Needs an empty hand: right-clicking a block places water there for 60 ticks; 80 ticks between uses.

kangaroo.notes: The rocket hops it about 6 blocks up and 5 forward every 5 s; fall damage is off only for 8 s after it hits a player.

kaya.notes: Grass blocks it places vanish under any other player who steps on them; its own steps never trigger them.

launcher.notes: Sponges it places throw anyone who steps on them straight up; the first landing within 15 s of a launch takes no fall damage.

monk.notes: Right-clicking a player with the rod moves their held item into their backpack; no damage, 5 s cooldown.

ninja.notes: After hitting a player it can crouch within 10 s to teleport onto them; 7 s between teleports.

poseidon.notes: Melee does 1.6x damage while it stands in water; Slowness I for 5 s after leaving water.

pyro.notes: 5 thrown fire charges: each lands as a power 1.5 explosion and ignites everything within 3 blocks for 5 s, except the Pyro.

reaper.notes: Every hit with the wooden hoe gives Wither I for 5 s, which can kill.

scorch.notes: With leather Flame Boots on and blaze powder in hand it leaves real fire 2 blocks behind every step; the fire burns it too.

snail.notes: Each hit has a 1 in 3 chance to give Slowness II for 5 s, on players and mobs.

soulstealer.notes: Its first death revives it invisible: 10 s to hit a player, then 10 s for that player to die, at 40% damage with a stone sword.

spiderman.notes: Each snowball lands as a 2x2 cobweb patch for 20 s; 3 throws, then 30 s; webs do not hold the Spiderman.

spy.notes: The compass reports the nearest opponent's position and kit and warns of anyone within 40 blocks; information only.

stomper.notes: Its own fall damage is capped at 4 (not zero) and the uncapped amount hits players within 5 blocks of the landing; starts with 16 ladders.

switcher.notes: A Switcher Ball that hits swaps the thrower's and target's positions; both immune for 3 s, 10 s between throws, 10 balls.

tank.notes: Explosions never damage it, and every player it kills explodes at power 4 where they died.

thor.notes: Right-clicking a block strikes lightning on the top of that column and shoves players within 4 blocks; 3 strikes, then 5 s.

timelord.notes: The watch freezes every other player and mob within 6 blocks for 10 s; a hit frees the victim; 40 s between casts.

turtle.notes: Crouching caps each hit at 2 damage and cancels its own attacks; the code leaves knockback unchanged, so no knockback immunity is recorded.

vampire.notes: A player kill heals 6, a mob kill 2; a kill taken unhurt for 10 s gives a splash vial that heals it and hurts others.

viper.notes: Each hit on a player has a 33% chance to give Poison I for 5 s; poison never kills.

werewolf.notes: Strength I and Speed I at night (13000-23000), Weakness I by day; wolves never attack it.

wisp.notes: Each magma cream spawns 5 harmless decoys in its skin and armour for 60 s; killing one costs the killer 1 heart.
